title: FTSE 100 today: Stocks rise as housing scheme lifts builders
summary: Investing.com -- British stocks rose on Monday as housebuilders surged after the government announced a state-backed equity loan scheme for first-time buyers.

title: Brent rises above $107/bbl as Iran, U.S. remain at odds over Hormuz reopening
summary: Investing.com-- Oil prices climbed nearly 3% on Monday after Iran said it would not soften its conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, after U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Tehran’s proposal, raising uncertainty over when traffic through the crucial oil shipping route will return to normal.

title: Colgate-Palmolive Has Paid a Dividend Since 1895. Does That Streak Still Deserves Your Money?
summary: Colgate-Palmolive has sent dividend checks without interruption since Grover Cleveland's second term, but a 130-year streak and a shrinking North American business now sit in uncomfortable tension with a premium valuation that leaves almost no room for error.

title: Trump: Oil prices will plummet after war ends ‘very soon’
summary: Investing.com -- Oil prices are set to fall sharply as soon as the war with Iran is over, U.S. President Trump said to reporters on Sunday as he boarded Marine One for Medinah, Illinois, pointing to the already increased oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz. He also said that U.S. negotiators are likely to engage in further talks with Iran this week, Axios reported, citing a phone interview.

title: Iran insists on diplomacy after Trump rejects Hormuz peace plan
summary: Investing.com -- Iran said diplomacy remained the only route to ending its conflict with the United States and Israel after President Donald Trump rejected Tehran’s proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and halt regional fighting, Reuters reported.
